sections.label: Mind
sections.text:
Dread of people, and desire to be alone.
Cannot do anything in the presence of others. Music
causes weeping. Despair, loathing of life. Fantastic
illusions. Pashfnl. Loss of love of life. Restless, ex-
cited, very loquacious. Time passes slowly. Thinking,
difficult in the morning with old people.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Slow comprehension. Vertigo, with weak-
ness in head and stomach. Tearing pain in upper half
of brain. Rush of blood to head, when listening to
music. Hearing impaired. Epistaxis, especially in the
morning. Profuse bleeding from teeth. Hair falls out.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Eructations, with violent, convulsive
cough. Acid eructations, like heartburn. Distention of
stomach and abdomen after midnight. Sensation of
coldness in abdomen.

sections.label: Urinary
sections.text:
Pain in bladder and rectum at the same
time. Burning in orifice of urethra and anus Feeling
in urethra as if a few drops passed out. Burning and
itching in urethra while urinating. Urine turbid, even
during emission, forming a brown sediment.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Nymphomania, Itching oj pudendum, with
soreness and snivelling. Menses too early. Profuse,
bluish leucorrhoea. Worse at night. Discharge of blood
between periods, at every little accident.

sections.label: Male
sections.text:
Voluptuous itching of scrotum. Parts ex-
terna41y numb; burn internally. Violent erections with-
out voluptuous sensations.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Asthmatic breathing with eructation
of gas. Nervous, spasmodic cough, with hoarseness
and eructation, on waking in morning; worse in pres-
ence of people. Tickling in throat, larynx and trachea,
chest oppressed, gets out of breath when coughing.
Hollozv, spasmodic, barking cough, coming from deep
in chest. Choking when hawking up phlegm.

sections.label: Heart

Palpitation, zvith pressure in chest as from
a lump lodged there, or os if chest was obstructed.
Conscious of the pulse. Palpitation in open air with
pale face.

sections.label: Sleep

Cannot sleep from zvorry; mUs^t get up.
Anxious dreams. Coldness of body and twitching of
limbs, during sleep.
